title: Monitoring of Patient Physiological Parameters in Real Life Using OXYFLEX® Biosensors Versus Standard Monitoring
official: Monitoring of Physiological Parameters in Real Life in Patients Managed in Anesthesia, Rehabilitation/Intensive Care Unit and Traumatology Services, Using OXYFLEX® Biosensors Versus Standard Monitoring
summary: The purpose of this study is to use the OXYFLEX® device in real care conditions during the hospital management of a population of patients from various hospital services. These services include patients from the severe trauma pathway, intensive care, the polyvalent intensive care unit, and the operating room. The objective is to assess the reliability of the data collected by the OXYFLEX® biosensor compared to those obtained from standard monitoring used in these different services and conditions.

interventions.name: Continuous monitoring of vital constants with OXYFLEX® biosensor.

sponsor: Centre Hospitalier Intercommunal de Toulon La Seyne sur Mer
